Reason-code glossary

CodeMeaning
ALERT_FOR_DURATION_UNREPRESENTABLEThe Prometheus alert for duration is invalid or cannot be represented by the target evaluation window.
ALERT_IMMEDIATE_WINDOW_APPROXIMATIONAn immediate Prometheus alert was mapped to the target's minimum rolling evaluation window.
ALERT_LABEL_TEMPLATE_FORMATTING_DROPPEDPrometheus-only alert-label formatting was reduced to a supported target variable, or an unsupported action was replaced with an explicit omission sentinel.
ALERT_NAME_DISAMBIGUATEDA duplicate source alert name received a deterministic suffix.
ALERT_THRESHOLD_NOT_EXTRACTEDA single numeric root threshold could not be separated from the PromQL expression.
ALL_TARGETS_DISABLEDEvery executable source target is disabled, which the target API cannot import safely.
ANNOTATION_QUERYThe dashboard contains a Grafana annotation definition that is not emitted.
ANNOTATION_TEMPLATE_FORMATTING_DROPPEDPrometheus-only annotation formatting was reduced to a supported target variable, or an unsupported action was replaced with an explicit omission sentinel.
BUILDER_FORMULA_EVALUATION_SEMANTICSSigNoz Builder formula evaluation uses different label matching, missing-series defaults, and non-finite handling than PromQL.
BUILDER_HISTOGRAM_PERCENTILE_SEMANTICSSigNoz Builder percentile evaluation does not preserve PromQL classic-histogram rate or increase and histogram_quantile semantics.
BUILDER_LATEST_LOOKBACK_SEMANTICSSigNoz Builder latest uses a bucket-local last sample and does not preserve PromQL selector lookback and stale-marker semantics.
BUILDER_OVER_TIME_SEMANTICSThe candidate maps a PromQL *_over_time range function to a SigNoz Builder time aggregation; equivalence is confirmed by the live differential.
BUILDER_RATE_INCREASE_SEMANTICSSigNoz Builder rate and increase use step-bucket deltas and do not preserve PromQL range extrapolation and reset handling.
BUILDER_TEMPORAL_PHASE_SHIFTThe Builder result matched the PromQL passthrough in magnitude but was offset by one step in time (e.g. SigNoz `latest` labels its bucket at the start); it is not temporally equivalent and was held at review rather than promoted natively.
BUILDER_VALUE_GROUP_BY_UNSUPPORTEDA grouped Builder scalar response cannot be rendered reliably by the target value panel.
CHAINED_VARIABLEThe variable query depends on another variable.
COMPARISON_IN_FORMULAA comparison cannot be represented safely as a Builder formula.
CUSTOM_VARIABLE_RELOAD_SEMANTICSPinned SigNoz rebuilds a custom variable from customValue on reload and ignores selectedValue; the emitted option set was reduced to a proven current selection or the variable was omitted.
DASHBOARD_LINKThe dashboard contains a link that is not emitted.
DATASOURCE_VARIABLE_OMITTEDThe datasource variable is omitted because the target has one SigNoz backend.
DYNAMIC_PROMQL_REWRITE_REQUIREDA grammar-changing variable prevents a required target-specific PromQL rewrite from being applied safely.
DYNAMIC_PROMQL_STRUCTUREA variable changes the PromQL grammar rather than a matcher value.
EMPTY_EXPRESSIONThe source target has no PromQL expression.
FIELD_OVERRIDESThe panel contains Grafana field overrides that are not emitted.
FIELD_THRESHOLDSThe panel contains Grafana field thresholds that are not emitted.
FORMULA_LABEL_SET_MISMATCHBuilder formula operands expose different label sets and cannot preserve PromQL matching.
GRAFANA_CONSTANT_VARIABLE_MUTABILITYGrafana constants are hidden immutable bindings, while pinned SigNoz represents them as visible editable textbox variables.
GRAFANA_EXPRESSION_TARGETThe target is a Grafana expression rather than a Prometheus query.
GRAFANA_GRAPH_RENDERING_DEFAULTSGrafana graph and time-series line, fill, and tooltip defaults are not all representable by the pinned SigNoz graph widget.
GRAFANA_INTERVAL_CONTROLGrafana query interval controls were materialized into an explicit target step and require review.
GRAFANA_PANEL_DESCRIPTION_SEMANTICSGrafana template-interpolates and renders panel descriptions as Markdown, while pinned SigNoz displays the stored description as plain tooltip text.
GRAFANA_QUERY_FORMATThe Grafana query requests a non-default result format whose target shaping is not proven equivalent.
GRAFANA_TIMESERIES_POINT_MODE_SEMANTICSGrafana time-series panels default to density-aware Auto points, while pinned SigNoz exposes only a fixed showPoints boolean.
GRAFANA_TRANSFORMATIONThe panel depends on a Grafana transformation that is preserved for review but not reimplemented.
GRAFANA_VARIABLE_FORMATA Grafana variable formatter has no proven executable SigNoz equivalent.
GRAFANA_VARIABLE_LEGEND_SEMANTICSGrafana query legends can use smart __auto naming, dashboard-variable interpolation, or missing-label placeholder behavior that pinned SigNoz does not reproduce exactly.
GRAFANA_VARIABLE_PANEL_TITLE_SEMANTICSGrafana and pinned SigNoz resolve dashboard variables in panel titles with different syntax and multi-value formatting.
HIDDEN_TARGETThe source target is disabled.
HISTOGRAM_BUCKET_FILTERA classic histogram bucket-label filter cannot be represented on a native histogram metric.
INSTANT_QUERY_UNSUPPORTEDGrafana instant-query evaluation cannot be represented by the target dashboard query model.
KEEP_FIRING_FOR_UNSUPPORTEDA positive Prometheus keep_firing_for duration has no equivalent target rule field.
LEGACY_PANEL_ALERTThe panel contains a legacy Grafana alert block that dashboard migration does not convert.
LIBRARY_PANEL_REFERENCEThe panel is a library-panel reference whose external model is unavailable in the export.
METRIC_METADATA_UNAVAILABLEThe target could not provide the metric metadata required to qualify a Builder candidate.
METRIC_NAME_REMAPThe target metric name differs from the source name.
METRIC_NAME_REMAP_COLLISIONDistinct source metrics would collapse to the same target metric within one PromQL expression.
METRIC_NAME_SEMANTIC_USE_AFTER_REMAPThe expression semantically reads __name__ while one of its metric selectors is renamed, so the target would observe a different label value.
METRIC_TYPE_INCOMPATIBLEThe target metric type or temporality is incompatible with the proposed Builder operation.
METRIC_TYPE_REQUIREDBuilder candidate qualification requires metric metadata from the target.
MISSING_METRIC_IN_TARGETThe referenced metric was not found in the target.
MISSING_VARIABLE_VALUEAn emitted query references a dashboard variable without a resolved value, so live validation was skipped.
MIXED_PANEL_QUERY_TYPESThe panel mixes native and passthrough queries and must use one target mode.
MULTI_VARIABLE_VALUE_UNRESOLVEDThe variable uses Grafana multi/All interpolation whose source-side escaping is not proven exactly; a declared target selection remains preserved, while a contradictory single-select array is omitted.
NATIVE_DIFFERENTIAL_VERIFIEDThe Builder query was confirmed numerically equivalent to its PromQL passthrough on the live target and emitted natively.
NONSTANDARD_QUANTILEThe histogram quantile is not supported by SigNoz Builder.
NON_EXACT_METRIC_SELECTORThe query does not select one metric by exact name and cannot be represented by Builder.
NON_PROM_DATASOURCEThe source query does not use a Prometheus-compatible datasource.
NO_QUERY_TARGETSThe source visualization has no executable query targets.
OPERATOR_OVERRIDEAn operator-provided Builder query replaced the generated translation; it is still verified live before it can be emitted natively.
PANEL_LINKThe panel contains a link that is not emitted.
PANEL_OMITTEDThe panel was deliberately omitted because emitting it would be invalid or misleading.
PANEL_TIME_OVERRIDEThe panel uses a source-specific time override.
PANEL_TYPE_DOWNGRADE_PROMQLThe visualization was changed to a graph because its SigNoz form cannot safely render PromQL.
PROMETHEUS_FOR_WINDOW_APPROXIMATIONA Prometheus for state transition was approximated with a trailing SigNoz evaluation window.
PROMETHEUS_LABEL_REMAP_COLLISIONDistinct source labels would collapse to the same target label during Prometheus receiver remapping.
PROMETHEUS_RESOURCE_LABEL_REMAPPrometheus job and instance labels were mapped to OpenTelemetry resource attributes.
PROMQL_PARSE_ERRORThe PromQL expression could not be parsed.
QUERY_NAME_COLLISIONExpanded Builder query names collide within the panel, so it uses PromQL instead.
QUERY_REFID_NORMALIZEDA missing or duplicate Grafana query reference was replaced with a deterministic unique name.
QUERY_RESULT_VARIABLEThe variable uses query_result semantics.
RANGE_STEP_MISMATCHThe PromQL range differs from the target evaluation step.
RATE_INTERVAL_REWRITEA Grafana rate interval was replaced with a fixed duration.
RECORDING_RULE_DEFINITIONThe source is a recording rule definition, not an alert rule.
RECORDING_RULE_INLINEDA Prometheus recording-rule expression was safely inlined for the target query.
RECORDING_RULE_METRICThe query references a recording-rule metric that may not exist in the target.
REGEX_VARIABLE_SEMANTICSA Grafana variable inside a regex matcher cannot be proven equivalent in a Builder filter.
REPEAT_PANELThe panel uses Grafana repeat behavior.
ROW_PANEL_TARGET_UNSUPPORTEDA Grafana row carries stale query targets; the row is emitted as structural layout only.
RULE_GROUP_INTERVAL_UNREPRESENTABLEThe explicit Prometheus rule-group interval is invalid or exceeds the emitted target evaluation window.
RULE_GROUP_LIMIT_UNSUPPORTEDThe Prometheus rule group uses a positive series limit, which has no target alert-rule equivalent.
RULE_GROUP_QUERY_OFFSET_UNSUPPORTEDThe Prometheus rule group uses query_offset, which has no target alert-rule equivalent.
SEVERITY_NORMALIZEDThe source severity was normalized to a target severity tier.
SUBQUERYPromQL subqueries are preserved as passthrough queries.
TABLE_JOIN_TRANSFORMThe panel depends on a Grafana table join transformation.
TARGET_ALERT_RUNTIME_LABELSPinned SigNoz v0.133 owns alertname and injects threshold.name, ruleId, ruleSource, and conditional nodata runtime labels that alter the alert label set and fingerprint.
TARGET_ONLY_LABEL_SEMANTIC_USEThe expression semantically consumes receiver-only labels before response normalization, so target-added values can change filtering, grouping, matching, label creation, series selection, or classic histogram evaluation.
TARGET_PROMQL_NATIVE_HISTOGRAM_DROPPEDPinned SigNoz serializes only float samples from PromQL matrices and silently drops native-histogram samples.
TARGET_PROMQL_RESPONSE_LABEL_STRIPPEDPinned SigNoz strips fingerprint and non-name double-underscore labels from PromQL responses, changing explicit output labels.
TARGET_RESOURCE_VECTOR_MATCHINGPromQL vector matching was rewritten over logical source labels to exclude known receiver-only attributes.
TARGET_RESOURCE_VECTOR_MATCHING_UNRESOLVEDKnown target-only labels require a PromQL vector-matching rewrite, but the operand output labels could not be proven exactly, so no executable query was emitted.
TEXT_PANELThe text panel has no query migration path.
TOPK_SEMANTICSPromQL and SigNoz apply top-k over different evaluation scopes.
UNMAPPED_DASHBOARD_CONFIGA source dashboard or legacy-row setting is inventoried but has no target representation.
UNMAPPED_QUERY_CONFIGA source query setting is inventoried but has no proven target representation.
UNMAPPED_VARIABLE_CONFIGA source variable setting is inventoried but has no target representation.
UNMAPPED_VISUALIZATION_CONFIGA source visualization setting is inventoried but has no target representation.
UNSUPPORTED_FUNCTIONThe PromQL function has no supported Builder candidate mapping.
UNSUPPORTED_MODIFIERThe query uses an offset or at modifier that is not represented safely.
UNSUPPORTED_OPERATORThe PromQL operator has no supported SigNoz Builder formula candidate mapping.
UNSUPPORTED_PANELThe panel visualization is not supported by the target emitter.
UNSUPPORTED_VARIABLEThe variable has no equivalent target representation and needs review.
VARIABLE_ALL_VALUE_SEMANTICSThe variable uses a custom Grafana All value whose matcher semantics differ from SigNoz matcher removal.
VARIABLE_REGEX_FILTERThe variable applies a Grafana regex filter that is not reproduced by a dynamic SigNoz variable.
VARIABLE_SELECTOR_SCOPE_DROPPEDA metric or matcher scope in a Grafana variable cannot be encoded by the target dynamic variable.
VARIABLE_VALUE_ESCAPING_UNRESOLVEDGrafana Prometheus interpolation and pinned SigNoz raw variable, reserved-time, or Go-template rendering cannot be proven to materialize the same query bytes.
VECTOR_MATCHINGPromQL vector matching has no equivalent Builder semantics.
VISUALIZATION_TYPE_DOWNGRADEThe closest target visualization does not preserve the source visualization type exactly.
WITHOUT_CLAUSEThe aggregation uses a without clause.
